scientific_limits: No evidence yet that compared segments are biologically or architecturally identical.
JPEG color similarity alone is not manuscript pigment composition.
Conservative dHash match is a triage candidate, not a 3D/fold reconstruction.
The 34 subimage grid tiles are computational search regions; their boundaries DO NOT map to confirmed rosette, tower or folded parchment panel boundaries.
Full-resolution JPEG links point to Yale's image service; this script did not HTTP-validate per-crop URLs. Images are also archived in verified GitHub source branch.
pair_review_protocol: Open BOTH original high-res source images and examine the cited normalized bounding boxes.
Record whether ROI belongs to pigment, drawing line, parchment background, photographic artifact or physical damage.
Annotate biological parts ROOT/LEAF/FLOWER/STEM, or architectural features TOWER/WALL/COLUMN only if visible.
Use color-blind grayscale outlines first; distinguish contour similarity from shared identity.
Document independent human verdict and a negative control before including any match in science claims.
